entry.title: New: Bill 94 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI" The purpose of this bill is to amend the FY 2024 Budget, Revenues, Operating Expenses, Capital Improvement Projects, Appendix A, Part II, and Appendix C to decrease the expenses and revenues for all funds except for the Bikeway Fund.
